brief.headline: Priority alert: possible self checkout skip scan on the self checkout camera.
observed: At 5.0 s: Bagging count rose to 2 with no scan in the two seconds before.
At 7.4 s: Bagging count rose to 3 with no scan in the two seconds before.
At 11.0 s: Bagging count rose to 5 with no scan in the two seconds before.
Bagged but not scanned was 2; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is -1 (range -1 to 0).
Left the basket but not scanned was 3; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 0 (range 0 to 1).
benign_explanations: The shopper placed their own bag on the bagging area.
One scan covered several identical items using the quantity key.
A barcode failed to read and the shopper has not yet noticed.
brief.recommended_action: Ask the host to pause the session and help the shopper rescan. Treat it as an honest mistake unless the review shows otherwise.
brief.confidence_note: Model risk is 1.00, which is strong evidence for this scenario. Pose tracking was clear throughout the clip.
